_comment: Uvicorn's --log-config. This exists for one process: the --reload reloader parent.
It never imports the app, so create_app's configure_logging() call never runs there and
its lines ('Will watch for changes', 'Started reloader process') keep uvicorn's own
untimestamped format. Config.__init__ reads this file in the parent and the child alike.
The format itself is not duplicated here -- build_formatter in app/core/logging.py is
named as the factory, so there is still exactly one definition of what a log line is.
